reason: Both methods compute the same condition: they return true iff the two dates fall on the same calendar day (same year, month, and day-of-month). The first method compares the day-of-year and year, which uniquely identifies a calendar day in any year, while the second method explicitly compares year, month, and day-of-month. For any pair of non-null Date objects, the two predicates are logically equivalent, and they throw the same exception (NullPointerException) when a null argument is supplied. No deterministic, bounded input can distinguish their behavior.
